name: JA_CN_FD_DFF_ASSIGNMENTS
description: This table contains context codes and column names for all descriptive flexfield used by programs of the solution for China Accounting Software Data Interface Standard. Each row includes the application ID and descriptive flexfield name, which can identify one descriptive flexfield. There is another column ''DESCRIPTIVE_FLEXFIELD_TITLE_CODE'' in this table, which contains codes that is used to define translatable description for descriptive flexfield shown in this table. ''DESCRIPTIVE_FLEXFIELD_TITLE_CODE'' column has one-to-one relationship with the combination of ''APPLICATION_ID'' and ''DESCRIPTIVE_FLEXFIELD_NAME''.

columns.name: DFF_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies the descriptive flexfield assignment row.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Chart of Accounts identifier for accounting key flexfield structure instance number.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: An identifier that uniquely identifies the application.

columns.name: CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Context code of the descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_COLUMN
columns.description: Attribute column that is defined for the context of descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
